Catalog number : M00285 Uniform title: kulasāra Secondary title: kaulasārasaṃgraha Secondary title: kulācāranirṇaya Manuscript : NGMCP 3-251 reel number A 150/16 Description: This manuscript is called Kulasāra, but is in fact a collection of fragment of three Kaula tracts. The first is Kaulsārasaṃgraha which, according to the colophons is a part of the Somabhujavalī. It begins with chapter 24 and extends up to to chapter 26. It is followed by the Kulaacāranirṇaya which extends from chapter 1 to 5. The third fragment is chapter eighteen of a work belonging to the śrīvidyā lineage of Subhagānandanātha. It deals with the funerary rites of a Kaula. The texts of which these are fragments in the format of a Tantra, outlining the principles of Kaula ritual and practice. They are typical Kaula work belonging to the latter period, that is, after the 13th century. Indeed such texts can be treated as an independent class of Kaula works of which the Kulārṇavatantra is one of the earliest. Notes: Revision 0: December 17, 2013 Publication country : India

text.body:
oṃ namaḥ śivāyai ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
ḍevadeva jagannātha sarvāṅgamavisārada | śrotumicchāmi tatvena kaulikānāṃ mataṃ vibho ||
kecid vadanti munayaḥ strīvargaphaladaṃ mataṃ | caturvargapradaṃ kecid vadanti muni sattamaḥ ||
tasyāśāmavidhiṃ deva śrotumicchāmichāmi tatvata | etanme saṃsayaṃ chindhi kenācin tamidaṃ sataṃ ||
śrī īśvara uvāca ||
ahaṃ te kathayīṣyāmi kulasāraṃ samāsata | etat prasanna mayā devi brahmāgre kathitaṃ purā ||
tato brahmā samāgreṇa nijagnāda yathā śṛṇu | devayāni yadā devi kvacinādenu jālaye ||
modayaḥ māsamantrārthi mṛtasaṃjīvamāya vai | tadātmānāṃdadau tasmai tatra satvaka visvarāṃ ||
madhyaṃ yātubhiḥ sarvatra hlālāmati vināsanī | tato devāṃ surāṃ tyaktvā somapārāsaṃkhyā(?) bhava ||
tvadva prabhuti devānāṃ balahānirajāyata | tadā devāraṇe jaghna dānavāmvargakāṃkṣiṇe ||
tadā mayā vidhi pṛṣṭo devānāṃ hitakāmyayā |
<1b>
kenopāyena deveśa devānāṃ vijayi bhavet | surāvihīnāstri daśā balahinā bhavaṃ ita ||
kathaṃ suddhi bhavet tasyā vāsā medhyā bhavennavā | kaulikaṃ matamādhyāyaṃ kimuvarga catusrayaṃ ||
prāpnuvanti yathāmartyo tanmetyaṃ vaktumarhasi |
brahmovāca ||
mayā śrutvā purā deva varṇāsra caturaḥ kilaṃ | tatra sarvasya varṇasya brāhmaṇaṃ gururucyate ||
taśoyamanyathā karṇaṃ kena sakyaṃ mayā vinā | taṃ sarvasya gurusākṣī vāgameto viśeṣataḥ ||
tanmedhyaṃ kuru mantreṇa girīśaṃ girījā priye | yena sāravyātpavitrāṇāṃ jāyate bhukti muktidāṃ ||
tadvā carusya vidhivadve vaidvipragaṇai saha | kauśikatvaṃmastraputra bhaviṣyati mamājñayā ||
caturvargañca sarvesāṃ tasminmārgo bhaviṣyati | viśeṣataḥ kaliyuge kaulikeśa muktibhājanāḥ ||
śrīsundaryāmanustatra pradhānaṃ kuru śaṃkari | satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satya satyameva punaḥ punaḥ ||
tvaṃ kṛtaṃ kaulikaṃ mārgaṃ svargadaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ |
<2a>
rajāsatyaṃ namasteti triguṇaṃ śrutayojagu ||
triguṇātmahaṃ bhavechakti triguṇaṃ śruyatāṃ punaḥ | pradhānaṃ puruṣo bhūtvā vinisākṣinidojaguḥ ||
pradhānavācyāṃ śaktistu puruṣo nirguṇātmakaḥ | sṛṣṭi sthiti vināsānāṃ vayaṃ kūrmastadājñayā ||
sāsmākaṃ paramāśakti sṛṣṭisthiti vināsane | sā tuṣyati hālātyānānta sarvaṃ kriyate paraṃ ||
tena mārgeṇa sarveṣāṃ bhuktimukti bhaviṣyati | tatra nindā prakuyuyesteṣāṃ hāri na saṃśayaḥ ||
śukraśrāpa vimocākṣaṃ tanmukhyānti kariṣyati | tena śrīmantrī japena paṃcaratnena mantritā ||
surāsura vrajanti tena tṛptā ca śrī sundarī | taddravyastu pitā sarve māmajñā viṣṇuśaṃrāhā(?) ||
tṛptā syuḥ sarvalokānāṃ bhuktimukti pradāyakā | kāraṇyaṃ śaktisaṃyuktaṃ pūjā karmaṇi kārayet ||
śrīsadaiva uvāca ||
iti tasya vaca śrutvā brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinaḥ |
<2b>
śukraśrāpavimocākṣaṃ mantrataṃ nirmitaṃ mayā | tasmādvargacaṣṭaṃ vai manuṣyā kaulike mate ||
tatra yuktaṃ mayā devi janmatvaṃ paripṛchasi | tadanyaṃ sarva nabhyake(?) śṛṇumatprāṇavallabhe ||
[iti śrīsomabhujavalyākulasārasaṃgrahe caturviṃśati paṭala] ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
purājaddamaladevaṃ toyoktaṃ vidhipūrvakaṃ | tustavyaṃ mantritaṃ dravyaṃ anyathā yatanaṃ bhavet ||
vinādravyādhivāsena mantrena smaraṃ bhavet | ye smaranti mahāmūḍhāsteṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ pade pade ||
na mantreṇa vināpānaṃ na pānānmanu cintayet | kathaṃ siddhe bhavedravyaṃ kenayā pūjanaṃ bhavet ||
darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ tatvatprokṣaṇaṃ dravyasuddhidaṃ | yonimudrā mṛtākhyā ca draṣṭavyā maṃtravisayai ||
tato guru kramaṃ kṛtvā gurupādamanusmaran | pātraṃ mevā pātramekaṃ kartavyaṃ mama desikaiḥ ||
tachipajyapanaṃ vālā paṃcaratnā mṛtājñayā | surāyā caiva gāyatrīmānanda bhairavantathā ||
ānanda bhairavī devī śukraśrāpa vimocanaṃ |
<3a>
ekaikaṃ cāṣṭavāla tu japtavyaṃ tarpayet tataḥ ||
dravyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca yāgālaṃ mudrāvāramadhujanaṃ | ānanda bhaiṣyayed devi ekākāraṃ namāmyahaṃ ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
devyāpratikarapañca trairvinānāccaraṃ bhavet | bhairavī cakramadhyasthaṃ sarvamedhyaṃ yathāmṛtaṃ ||
sarve parṇādvijāstatra na vikārosti kiñcana | tripātraṃ pañcapātraṃ vā saptapātramathāpi vā ||
yāvannasmahyaṃte kiṃcit tāvat pānaṃ pracakṣyate | asaskāraṃ bhavedravyaṃ balātkāreṇa maithunaṃ ||
ubhayoḥ secanāddevi viropi narakaṃ vrajet | ājñāyāṃ saṃgrahe devi iti śāstrasya nirṇayaṃ ||
ekapātraṃ kṛtaṃ pānaṃ brahmahatyādi pātakaṃ | śaktyuchiṣṭaṃ pibedravyaṃ vīrochiṣṭaṃ tu carvaṇī ||
vīrochiṣṭaṃ tathādravyaṃ śaktyuchiṣṭaṃ tu carvaṇī | cakramadhya na kartavyaṃ manyathā patanaṃ bhavet ||
yadā nandā vasā devi śaktiprārthayate nara | maithunaṃ tatrā kartavyaṃ nātra kārya vicāraṇāt ||
3b>
yāga dvitīyaṃ kartavyaṃ tena dravyeṇa mokṣadaṃ | kvacitpānaṃ kvaciddhyānaṃ kvaciccarvanamācaret ||
carvaṇena vināpānaṃ kevalaṃ viṣavarddhanaṃ | carvaṇe yajaṃ pāna mamṛtaṃ parikīrtitaṃ ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
dravyaṃ kaṭiprakārasyāt pātraṃ vā kena nirmitaṃ | śaktipadavirūpākṣa kīdṛśaṃ śaktiruttamaḥ ||
īśvara uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi dravyaṃ yāvad bhavedihaṃ | gauḍī pauṣṭi tathā mādhvī khārjurī nārikelajā ||
tālajātandulādhyā ca drākṣī cāṣṭavidhāṃ surā | gauḍī guḍodbhavā proktā paiṣṭipiṣṭakasaṃbhavā ||
mādhvī madhukajā devi chasarvataṇḍulodbhavya | gauḍī bhogavidā grāhyā mādhvī mukti pradāyanī ||
sarvasiddhi karī paiṣṭī kharjurī ripunāsanī | tālajasthaṃbhane proktā nārikelaṃ ca mohane ||
ākarṣanoccāṭanaṃ proktamāsavaṃ māraṇe vidha | drākṣarājya pradaṃ grāhyāṃ hydanyaṃdābhicārake ||
<4a>
gajavāji narāṇāṃ ca gavāmeṣa varāhayoḥ | māhiṣaṃ khaḍagaṃ caiva māhāmāsāṣṭakaṃ priye ||
rajakī caiva kaivartī cāṇḍālī ca valāṃgaṇau | gopāraṇī ca gaṇīkā puṣpalityātma śaktayaḥ ||
hīnādhikāṃgidhivṛttā karkasā karahārthanī | kṛpābhaktiṃ ca rahitā varjanī pārvanā vidhau ||
suśruktā muditā śaktā surūpā śakti secitā | pūjanīyā prayatnena kuladharmānuvartanī ||
bahuparjyusitaṃ dravyaṃ yaddravyaṃ gandhavarjinī | uchiṣṭaṃ caiva durgandha varjatīrthanidasasaṃ ||
putrīmucheṣṭamāṃsaṃ tu nāgrāhyaṃ desikai kvacit | grāhyate dīkṣitā sarve ekapātreṇa saṃgrahe ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
kadā pūjā prakartavyaṃ śaktiṃ tīrthā bhave ca kiṃ | madobhāvena kiṃ grāhya śaktyārbhāve bhave ca kiṃ ||
phalaṃ nityārcanaṃ kiṃ vā arcite vā bhave ca kiṃ | aśaktena paśuṃbhitvā jayā nityārcanaṃ bhavet ||
tadā kiṃ vā prakartavyā pātraṃ vā kena nirmitaṃ |
<4b>
ādhāraṃ kena kartavyaṃ tatra mokṣārta marhasi |
śrī īśvara uvāca ||
nitya pūjā prakartavyaṃ paṃcaparvaṇi yā kvacit | māsamekena kartavyamarcanastrividhi mataṃ ||
aṣṭamī navamī caiva caturdaśyāṃ pārvaṇena tu | ekādaśyāṃ sevatevaṃ sarvadeva maheśvari ||
uttamānitya pūjā syāt paṃcaparvaṇi madhyamā | adhamāmāsa pūjāsyānmāsādūrddha paśuṃ bhavet ||
sarvadharma paribhraṣṭa kaulodharmasamācaret | kaulodharma paribhraṣṭa rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet ||
dugdhadadhighṛtaṃ jautaṃ tailaṃ sauverasaṃbhavā | ādrayuktaṃ pravānambā nārikerajalaṃ tathā ||
abhāvādaṣṭamidaṃ proktaṃ dravyā bhāve tu sundari | matsyavālāvataṃ caiva kukkuṭaṃ vākapiṃjalaṃ ||
piṃnyākaṃsvinamāṃsaṃ ca lavanaṃ cādrakaṃ priye | abhāve cāṣṭamāṃsāni gṛṣṭini sarvadārcanaṃ ||
śaktyābhāve sureśāni svātmaśakti prapūjayet | pānaṃ ca trividhaṃ proktaṃ daivavīrapaśu kramāt ||
<5a>
devadevyā gatapānaṃ śaktimāṃsāsake tribhiḥ | ekānte tatra kartavyaṃ makāraṃ paṃcakai budhiḥ ||
mahāmāṃnsaṃ ca matsyaṃ ca mudrāmaithunameva ca | makārapaṃcakaṃ kṛtvā punarjanma na vidyate ||
udyān bhūmau maunyāsādin kṛtvā murddhi trikoṇakai | tatpītvā vivedyetastu vīrapāṇau mṛtāhṛtaṃ ||
maṃtrayantra vihīna ca paśupānamataparaṃ | kāṃcajaṃ rajataṃ muktā pravālothya ca kāṃcanaṃ ||
sphāṭikā nārikelākṣaṃ narakā vālamuttamaṃ | sarvakāmapradaṃ hemaṃtrātālaṃ sarvasamṛddhidaṃ ||
sphāṭikaṃ vaśyadaṃ nṝṇāṃ nārikelāṣṭasiddhidā | abhicāra padaṃ kāca ākarṣeṣu pravālakaṃ ||
mauktikaṃ muktidaṃ nṛṇākāpālaṃ mantrasiddhidaṃ | tāmrakāṃśastathā lohaṃ mṛnmayaṃ kāṣṭajaṃ tathā ||
trilohisthiṃvisosthi varjayet pātramidrisaṃ | ādhārasyā trilohiyā pātroktā vastubhistathā ||
tāmrakāṃśaṃ varjayitvā sarvamādhārajojñatāṃ |
<5b>
[iti śrīsāmabhujavalyāṃ kaurasārasaṃgrahe devadevīsaṃvāde paṃcaviṃśati paṭala] ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
ahiṃsā paramodharmaṃ kaṭivedavidopurā | kathitaṃ yattvayā deva viruddhaṃ tvadidaṃ dhruvaṃ ||
prāṇahiṃsā mahāghorā kathaṃ kuryānmahāsayān | saṃsayaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ deva kathaṃ pūjā samācaret ||
śrī īśvara uvāca ||
śivaśaktisamāropyaṃ bhedābheda na saṃśayaḥ | īśvarī vandite pūjā niṣkāmaṃ karmasaṃgrahe ||
naraprāṇi vadhe pāpaṃ na surāsvādṛte tathā | parastrī gamanaṃ tadvadyanyaṃ dṛśye kṛte kṛte ||
kaulikā naiva vādhyante pātakā brahmahādaye | yathāpadmapalāseṣu nasyanti jalavindavaḥ ||
api brahmāvadhaṃtvā ca smitasaṃ kuruto yadi | pātramantaṃ yutalabdhaṃ tatpānaṃ casyati dhruvaṃ ||
bhairavī cakramadhyasthaṃ nalabddha pisitaṃ yadi | tadarthaṃ gāṃca vipraṃ ca hanyā doṣo na vidyate ||
ācāra labhate hyāpurācārādi smitā prajā |
<6a>
ācārabandhanamapi devatā ca prasiddhati | ācārasarvadā tyājyo munibhirjadudā hṛtaṃ ||
ācārahīna puruṣaṃ kaulikaṃ paśumeva vā | tridhā devī ca sevante tasya mantreṇa kiṃ phalaṃ ||
prāyaścittaṃ bhṛgupātaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ vratadhāriṇaṃ | tīrthajātrādi gamanaṃ kaulāḥ paṃcavivarjayet ||
yaṃ naraṃ vādhyate pāpaṃ prāyaścitte na tatkṛte | bhṛgupāta mayānāṃ ca mahāpātakanāsanaṃ ||
sarvakāmaphalaṃ nyāsaṃ paramāheśvarī jale | sarvavrataphalaṃ prapto kulaputrasya vartate ||
vāruṇī bindumātreṇa tīrthakoṭi phalaṃ labhet | api sarveṣu pāpeṣu prāyaścitta mudāhṛtaṃ ||
kuladharmaviraktānāṃ na dṛśyaṃ na śruti kvacit | yā nityaṃ pūjayen mantrī tāṃ māteva putravat ||
śrīcakra madhyaga kaścidbhairavaṃ kurute yadi | tataḥ sarve taduchiṣṭaṃ bhoktavyaṃ na śrutena tu ||
yatsūtraṃ vikriyāṃ kuryān mānavaṃ saiva sudhyati | api kuṣṭena sarvāgaṃ vyāpani mānava kvacit ||
śrīcakraseṣa uchiṣṭaṃ bhojayet saśuṣi bhavet |
<6b>
brahmāviṣṇu kuverendrāḥ sarve śrīcakravartanaṃ | mānavaṃ pūjayettevaṃ sāpatatu na saṃśata ||
api kiṃ bahunoktena brahmabhūtodi sā naraḥ | ya kaulikaṃ pathaprāptā brāhmadvārasya kiṃ naraḥ ||
vaiśyasyaṃ bhānukarṣeṇa videśoścāṭanāraṇaṃ | japasmi vibhavo nūnaṃ tasya tulya kathaṃ surā ||
[iti śrīsomabhujagalyāṃ kulasārasaṃgrahe ṣaṭviṃśatipaṭala] ||
oṃ namaḥ śrītripurāyai ||
athātasaṃpravakṣyāmi samayācārapaddhatiṃ | yo jñātvā ca mahādevi sādhakā siddhimāpnuyāt ||
īśvara uvāca ||
na laṃghayed gurorājñāmuttaraṃ na vadet tathā | rātrau divā tathājñā ca dāsavat paripālayet ||
sthānāntara gaterānta veśanāmukti cetana | śrīguruvyāpitaṃ nityaṃ dādiṣṭaṃ ca tato vrajet ||
uktārukteṣu kārjeṣu nopekṣākārayet kvacit | gachataḥ pṛṣṭhato gachedgurośchāyā na laṃghayet ||
anādṛtya gurorvākyaṃ śṛṇupādaparāṅmukhaṃ |
<7a>
ahītamvāhitaṃ vāpi rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet | evaṃ bhūta guruṃ caiva nāvamanyavicakṣaṇaḥ ||
ājñābhaṃgo guroddevi pakkaroti vimūḍhadhīḥ | sayāti narake ghore piśācatva mavāpnuyāt ||
ājñābhaṃgaṃ tathā nindā guroścaiva pravartanaṃ | gurudrohaṃ ca yatkuryāt tachaṃgannaiva kārayet ||
gurudravyābhilākhaṃ ca gurustrī gamane tathā | pātakatva sthirastasya prāyaścittena notyajet ||
guruhuṃkatyahuṃkṛtya ciprānirjitya vādata | araṇyanirjane deśe sa bhavedbrahmarākṣasaḥ ||
pādukāmāsanaṃ vastraṃ śayanaṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca | dṛṣṭvā gurornamaskṛtvādātmabhogaṃ na kārayet ||
sadā śrīpādukāmantraṃ jihvāgre yasya vartate | anāyāsena dharmārthaṃ kāmamokṣaṃ labhet tasaṃ ||
mahāroge mahotpāte mahādurge mahābhaye | mahāpade mahāpāpe trāyata gurupādukāṃ ||
vande gurupade dvandve saccidānaṃdavigrahaṃ | śvetaraktavibhāgoyaṃ śivaśaktyātmakaṃ paraṃ ||
<7b>
śrīnātha padāmbhojaṃ yasya diśi virājate | tasya diśi namaḥ kuryāt kāyena manasāgirā ||
ekagrāmasthitaḥ śiṣyastrisaṃdhyaṃ praṇamedguruṃ | dūradeśe sthitaḥ śiṣyo māsaika praṇamedguruṃ ||
vidyāgamānasaṃ mantraṃ mantratantrādhikaṃ priye | sarvagurumukhāllabdhā sakalaṃ nānyathā dhruvaṃ ||
kapaṭe valake caiva praśāde saṃkate tathā | dīrghakāṣṭe śilāpṛṣṭe gurorekāsanaṃ priye ||
yadyadātmahitaṃ vastu taddravyaṃ naiva vaṃcayet | śrī guroḥ pādukāmantre mūlamantrasya pādukāṃ ||
śuśiṣyebhyo vade devi na navadedyasya kasyacit | gurostarpaṇamarpyaṃ ca tena tuṣyāmi suvrate ||
guroḥ sevā paro yastu tasya tuṣyāmi suvrate | bhaktyācintānusāreṇa gurumuddeśya yatkathaṃ ||
svalpena mahaditapuṃ tulyamanyaṃ daridrayā | sarvasvamapi yo dadyādgurubhakti vivarjitaḥ ||
sanadaḥ kleśasamāpnoti bhaktireva hi kāraṇaṃ | gurustrī putravandhūnāṃ doṣaṃ naiva prakāsayet ||
bhakṣaye secataṃ dravyaṃ na dadyānnopasakṣaye | kumārī kanyakā vīrā yoginī kaulikā api ||
<8a>
anyajātyādi vanitā nāpamānyāṃ kadācana | satāparādhāmapitaṃ puṣpaṃ nāpi na tāḍayet ||
doṣaṃ nagaraṇa ye divyā gunānaiva prakāśayet |
[iti śrīkulāścaranirṇaye gurubhaktiparichamo nāma prathama paṭala] ||
vinā dravyādhi vāsena na japenna smaret priye | ye yajanti mahāmūḍhāsteṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ pade pade ||
devyuvāca ||
na dravyena vinā mantra na mantreṇa vināṃguliḥ | parasparavirodhitvā kathaṃ pūjā vidhīyate ||
ālokyājjighraṇāddhyānānnānā dravya viśuddhyati | tatpītvā sarvamantrāṇāṃ smaraṇaṃ yajanaṃ hitaṃ ||
pañcaddravyasya mantreṇa kuryāt saṃskāramuttamaṃ | śuddhena tena deveśi tarpayet kuladevatāṃ ||
vīkṣaṇaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ dhyānaṃ mantramudrādi sodhitaṃ | taddravyaṃ sparśayogyaṃ syādanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet ||
sadā bhaktiśu saṃpanyo mantrarādhana tatparaṃ | mantropadeśa sahitaṃ kuladravyaṃ samarpayet ||
sa savyaṃ yonakhaiḥ kuryāt kuladravyasya tarpaṇaṃ |
<8b>
devatāsāpamāpnoti satyametan maheśvari | aṃguṣṭhā bhairavo devī madhyamā caṇḍikā matā ||
madhyamāṃguṣṭayogena tarpayet kuladevatāṃ | aṃguṣṭānāmikābhyāṃ ca tarpayeddharmakarmaṇi ||
tarjanyaṃguṣṭayogena tarpayedabhicārake | kaniṣṭāṃguṣṭayogena stambhane bhūtakarmaṇi ||
anyathā kurute yastu tarpaṇaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet | yāvanna vaṭukaṃ dadyāttāvannaiva kuleśvari ||
sundarye prathamaṃ datte pūjā ca(?) tri(?)sphalā | tṛpyantu mātaraḥ sarvāḥ sa rudrāgaṇadevatāḥ ||
dakṣiṇe vaṭukaṃ dadyāduttare yogiṇī valiṃ | pūrve bhūtavaliṃ dadyāt sthānapālāśca paścime ||
rājarājeśvarī madhya pūjayet parameśvarīṃ | aṃguṣṭānāmikābhyāṃ tu vaṭukasya valiṃ haret ||
kaniṣṭāṃguṣṭayogena yoginīnāṃ baliṃ haret | aṃguṣṭatarjanībhyāñca kṣetrapāla baliṃrmataḥ ||
aṅgulībhiśca sarvābhirukto bhūtavaliṃ priye | aṅguṣṭamadhyamābhyāṃ ca rājarājeśvaraṃ tathā ||
devatārthaṃ yathāśāstraṃ kuladravyaṃ samarpayet | labhate vāṃchitaṃ sarvaṃ matprasādānnasaṃśayaḥ ||
[iti kulācāranirṇaye śivapraṇite dvitīyapaṭalaḥ] ||
<9a>
matkarmakurvatāṃ puṃsāṃ karmalopo bhavedyati | tatkurmate prakurvanti kulācāravidhānataḥ ||
tatkurmakurvatā śreṣṭā triṃśatkoṭyo marharṣayaḥ(?) | maṇḍalena vinā pūjā nisphalā kathitā priye ||
tanpūjayedvidhivattāmeva parameśvari | akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ viśvaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitaṃ ||
trailokyaṃ maṇḍitaṃ yena maṇḍalastu sadāśivaḥ | oḍiyānaṃ caturasraṃ kāmarūpastu vartulaṃ ||
jālandharamarddhacandraṃ tāmraṃ pūrṇagirirbhavet | ādhāraṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ ṣaṭpadaṃ vā catuṣpadaṃ ||
athavā vartulaṃ kuryāt ramaṇīyaṃ manoharaṃ | svarṇaraupya śilā kurmā kapālāsvāvumṛnmayaṃ ||
nārikelañca śaṃkhañca muktāsuktisamudbhavaṃ | punyavṛkṣe samudbhūtaṃ pātraṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
tāṃmrakāṃśyādi lohañca pātraṃ naiva tu kārayet | patraṃ puṣpāṃ kulaphalaṃ mūlavalkaladhānyajaṃ ||
rasavṛkṣaṃ latātālaṃ dravyaṃ daśavidhi smṛtaṃ | pāla(*?)drādhamādhūkaṃ khārjuraṃ tālamaikṣavaṃ ||
mādhūkamāsavaṃsidhūmaireyaṃ nārikelajaṃ |
<9b>
madyamekādaśetāni bhuktimukti pradāni ca | dvādaśaṃ ca surādravyaṃ sarvasmāduttamottamaṃ ||
kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ māhyavalkalasaṃbhavaṃ | madhupuṣparasodbhūta māsavaṃ tandūlodbhavaṃ ||
sarvasiddhikari yaiṣṭi gauḍibhoga pradāyini | mādhvī muktikarī proktā drākṣīrājya pradāyinī ||
tālajāstambhane prokta khārjurī ripu nāśinī | nārikela bhavāśrīdāpānaṃ saukhya matā sadā ||
mādhvī jñāna pradā proktā sāriṣṭāroga hāriṇī | māṃsantu trividhaṃ proktaṃ jale khecarabhūcarāḥ ||
gonarebhāsvamahikho varāhaṃ ca mṛgotavaṃ | mahāmāṃsāṣṭakaṃ devi devatā prīti kārakaṃ ||
nakhaiḥ prajupitaiḥ ramlairdūrgandhairgandhavarjitaiḥ | hetubhiḥ parapātrachetarpitaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet ||
ariṣṭaiśca vasārīya dravyairamṛtasannibhai | tarpaṇaṃ ca maheśāni sarvakāmaphalapradaṃ ||
dravyamāṃsādyabhāvena nityaṃ karmaṃ ca lopayet | pramādādyadi lopaścedrauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet ||
takraṃ kṣīraṃ guḍaṃ kṣaudraṃ dadhyājyatilaśarkarā |
<10a>
vailamayyāraṇālaṃ ca dravyaṃ daśavidha smṛtaṃ | lavanādrakapiṇyākaṃ godhūmaṃ māṃsapaṃcakaṃ ||
guṃjanaṃ ca maheśāni māṃsaṃ daśavidhaṃ smṛtaṃ | ukteṣu teṣu caikeṣu yathāśaṃbhavavastunā ||
aṣṭagaṃdhācca jāyante rasairebhista tarpayet | śaṃkhaṃ sarvodakṣaścaiva valipātrāṇi vai kramāt ||
dakṣādi vāmācāryastu sthāpayitvā piṣṭajayet | anivedyaṃ ca yaḥ śaktiḥ kuladravyaṃ niṣevate ||
devatā sāpamāpnoti pūjā ca nisphalā bhavet | svaśakti guruśaktiṃ vā dīkṣitāṃ guru vaktrataḥ ||
gāyayitvā pivedravye'ti śāstravidovidu | ganikā śauṇḍinī caiva kaivartīrajakī tathā ||
tantukārī ca kāmārī mātaṃgī undhasī tathā | kulāṣṭakamidaṃ proktaṃ maṃgalāṣṭakamucyate ||
kumārī vā vratasthā vā yogamudrādharāpi vā | pūjākāle ca yā proktā tarpaṇaṃ sahajā budhaiḥ ||
pūjā sadyaṃganā bhāve cāturvarṇaṃ dināṃ vrajet | surūpā taruṇī śāntā sukulāmuditā śuci ||
<10b>
aṃgapūrṇā bhaktiyuktā kulaśāstreṇa dīkṣitā | manoharā sadācārā śaktireṣā sulakṣaṇā ||
duṣṭogrā karkaśā krurā kukṣitā kuladūkṣitā | dūrācārā parādhīnā satyahīnāntu lālasā ||
nidrāti yuktādurmedhā hīnāṃgī vyādhi pīḍitā | kudṛśī śatruyuktāṣi dūtīyāge vivarjitā ||
[iti śrīkulācāre śivokte tṛtīyapaṭala] ||
atha kaulikā na gataṃ tripurā devyā pārvaṇaṃ nidānaṃ likhyate |
vyatipāte ca śaṃkrāntau grahaṇacandrasūryayoḥ | deśikācārya yoginyordine yasmin samāgatāḥ ||
sādhakānāṃ nikṣante palāli vali niṣṭaya | anyathā vimukhāyānti gururindra marīcayaḥ ||
phalguvali viraktaṃ ca yojayen paścimaṃ kramaṃ | yoginyastasya kupyanti śoṣayantī rasāmiṣaṃ ||
iti kaulikāntarmataṃ tripurādevyā upacāravidhi ||
madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā matsyaṃ mudrāmaithunameva ca | makāraṃ pañcakaṃ kṛtvā punarjanma na vidyate ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
pravante gopanī cakre sarve varṇaṃ dvijātayaḥ |
<11a>
nivṛrte yoginī cakre sarve varṇāḥ pṛthak pṛthak | ekacakraṃ pṛthak pātraṃ jyeṣṭānu kramataṃ kṛtaṃ ||
sāmayeḥ sādhakaḥ putra ācāryo yoginī tathā | ekacakraṃ kulīnānāṃ ye kecilliyabhājanāḥ ||
etaiḥ sahaprakartavyamannai saha na saṃśayaḥ | ekapātraṃ na kartavyaṃ na kartavyaṃ pṛthak pṛthak ||
saṃprāpya dravya carikamekacintaḥ samāhitaḥ | vikalpo nātra kartavyaṃ kṛte ca maraṇaṃ bhavet ||
nirveśaṃ kena cittena bhaktyāsaṃyamanaṃ kṛtaṃ | tenasyeti bhavenmuktirgurvendu sadṛso bhavet ||
prāpnoti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatsurairapi durlabhaṃ | ete vai kaulikācāraṃ jñātvāsiddhimavāpnuyāt ||
āgate melake vāpi abhiṣekaṃ ca parvaṇi | pūjārthamāhare phalgunātmārthantu kadācana ||
vidhairyuktaṃ tu deveśi pārvanaṃ cācare śubhaṃ | yajña koṭi phalaṃ tasya hemabhāraśatāstathā ||
datvā tu kaulikebhyaśca bindumātrālisaṃganāt | pṛthivī hema(?)pūrṇā ca kanyā koṭi pradānataḥ ||
tatphalaṃ śaktidānañca kaulike yāgamandire |
<11b>
anekapuṣpasaṃbhāraiḥ koṭiliṃga pratiṣṭavān | tatphalaṃ labhate devi yoginī varadā bhavet ||
vighnāni na bhavanteva nirvighnā siddhitāṃ bhavet | tṛpyanti mātaraḥ sarvāḥ sa gaṇāḥ sa vināyakāḥ ||
tṛpyanti devanivaho brahmadvāmunayaḥ śivāḥ | brahmākṣatra tathā vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ cāparameva ca ||
kriyāhīnamavettāraṃ śaktijñānaṃ vivarjitaṃ | lobhārthibhiḥ pravṛttānāmayeyāṃ pivate surāṃ ||
tapaścaścātra(?) kartavyaṃ patanaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ | guru daiva tathāśāstraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kramayoginī ||
āvāhayet prayoge ca sparśanaṃ siddhivān bhavet | saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ rauravānikṛtāni ca ||
dravyadarśanamātreṇa niṣpāpo bhavati kṣaṇāt | vaidyaśāstre tathā brahmo prabhakte ca viśeṣataḥ ||
dṛṣṭamātreṇa kartavyaṃ siddhihāniśca jāyate | ghṛṇā śaṃkā na kartavyā yadicheccirajīvitaṃ ||
anāhusyo na yacheta āhuto yonino viśet | tasya saṃgrahato devi śāpamāpnoti mūrddhani ||
cakramadhya tu yaṃ vṛttaṃ śubhasvāya divā śubhaṃ |
<12a>
prabhāte tanuvaktavyaṃ mityājñā pārameśvarī | na bhakṣaḥ viyate kiṃcinnāyayamapi vidyate ||
guruvīravadhūṃ tyaktā ramyāḥ sarvāśca yoṣitaḥ | ye viṣanti mahādevīṃ ye viṣanti ca yoginīṃ ||
teṣāṃ ca nigraho devī ādyāpīṭha vicārataḥ | ye nindantu sādhakāḥ sarve vinaśyaṃ tu vidūṣakāḥ ||
avasthā śāmbhavī mentu prasannostu guruḥ sadāḥ | divājñasamayākhyātaṃ rātravīdu divā smṛtāḥ ||
prakāśena vibhāgantu jñātvā rātrau prapūjayet | ye vastuvanti nindanti varṇayenna ca kaulikā ||
śrīmato jñānino vīsukhino yanmayanmani | yadi nipidhatorthā sā kaulikāḥ paśumichati ||
svādodharmaśca hāniśca yoginī sāpamāpnuyāt | gurvarthatyajetpānaṃ devārthantu mathāpi vā ||
devyāgrahastaṃto bhūtvā mātṛtaḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha | kulamārgaṃ samāsādyaṃ yo naraḥ pravalāyitaḥ ||
samahā pātakī devi prayāsantu na kārayet | niyuktā parayogena dharmasyā vakṣaṇāya ca ||
[ityādipīṭhāvatāre kaulikavidāne kutrikātantre(?) kramaśūtraṃ samayācāracaturthapaṭalasamāpta] ||
<12b>
pāṇabhedapramāṇaṃ ca galī lakṣaṇameva ca | avijñāyā cared yastu sa bhavedāpadāpadaṃ ||
anumūlatrikoṇodya koṭisūryasamaprabha | kuṇḍaliśaktividvahnau kuladravyaṃ samantṛkāṃ ||
carukaṃ siddhidaṃ proktaṃ dīpojñāna pradāyakaṃ | pānātparataraḥ prāptiḥ kaule tritayamuttamaṃ ||
gurudaivatamantrāṇāṃmaikyaṃ saṃcintayeddhiyāṃ | yāvadūllāsaparyantaṃ upadeśaiḥ pibenmadhuṃ ||
carvaṇena yutaṃ pānaṃ mamṛtaṃ parikīrtitaṃ | carvaṇena vināpānaṃ kevalaṃ viṣavarddhanaṃ ||
pānaṃ ca trividhaṃ proktaṃ divyavīrapaśu kramāt | divyaṃ devyāgrataḥ pānaṃ vīramekāntavāsinaṃ ||
svechayā paśupānañca paśupānamiti smṛta | vidhimantravihīnaṃ ca paśupānamataḥ paraṃ ||
bhuktimuktistathā bhukti narakaṃ tatphalaṃ priye | yāvanna carate dṛṣṭi yāvanna carate manaḥ ||
tāvatpānaṃ prakartavyaṃ paśupānamataḥ paraṃ | pūrṇābhiṣekahīnāṃga pānamatyanta durgati ||
pūrṇābhiṣeka yuktānāṃ pānamatyantu meṣyate | pītvā pītvā puna pītvā pītvā patati bhūtale ||
<13a>
uthāya ca punaḥ pītvā punarjanmo na vidyate | pātraṃ brahmārasoviṣṇubbudbudorudradevatā ||
āmodāśekharaṃḥ prokta ānandantu sadāśivaḥ | ichāśaktiḥ surāmode jñānaśaktiśca tadrase ||
kriyānmā ca sadānande tasmāt syevyaṃ sadā priye | dravyaṃ śaktiḥ śivo māṃsaṃ tadbhoktā bhairava svayaṃ ||
tattulyāsaḥ parāśakti ānando mokṣa ucyate | ānando brahmaṇo rūpaṃ tacca dehe vyavasthitaṃ ||
tasmācca vyaṃjakaṃ dravyaṃ yogibhistena pīyate | gāyanti gāyakāmantā mantādhyāyanti yoginaḥ ||
ramanti kāmukāmattā mattāḥ kurpanti kopinaḥ | mantrāṇā smaraṇārthādi manasaṃsthīra hetave ||
bhayakleśa nivṛtyarthamalimāṃsaṃ samācaret | nantārthaṃ sarvadevānāṃ brahmajñāna sthirāya ca ||
sevante madhumāṃsāni na laulyāñca kadācana | ghṛtakumbha sahasrāṇi kṣīrakumbhaśatāni ca ||
alinā bindumātreṇa kalānārhanti ṣoḍaśī | candrārkāgni saṃparkā galitat parāsṛtaṃ ||
tenāmṛteradivyena tarpayedyai guruṃ parāṃ |
<13b>
śrīguroḥ kulaśāstrebhyaḥ samyak jñānakulena vā | kuladravyaṃ niṣedena yāyate nānyathā priye ||
gurayo paramākāśaṃ saccidānandalakṣaṇaṃ | kuladravyānubhāna (*) jāyate nānyathā priye ||
antarānantarātmānaṃ manovācirageva ca | saṃrasāmṛtapāṇena jāyate nānyathā priye ||
(*?) dhakaṃ jagatsarvaṃ tavamāsadāhṛtaṃ | siddhadravyai kaulikānāṃ kulīnāya prakāsayet ||
mantrasaṃskārasaṃśuddhyamamṛtaṃ pānapārvati | jāyate devatābhāva mahāpātakanāśanaṃ ||
susaṃskṛtāsurārogyaduḥkhadāridrahāriṇī | asaṃskṛtā bhavedoga kalahaṃ vyādhiḥ duḥkhahā ||
bhairavāṣṭamidaṃ dravyaṃ śuddhaṃ dravyaistu tarpayet | brahmahatyā bhruṇahatyā vinaśyati na saṃśayaḥ ||
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpamalibindurvināśayat | paśupānavidhau pītvā vīropi narakaṃ vrajat ||
liṃgayoni vibhedena rauravai narakaṃ vrajet | asaṃskāraṃ pibed dravyaṃ balātkāreṇa maithunaṃ ||
svahastena paśuṃ hatvā rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet | tarpaṇo homahīnañca śaktihīnañca śaktīhīna ca yojayet ||
<14a>
dvitīyena vihīnañca tarpaṇaṃ nisphalaṃ bhavet | ajñātvā tu kulācāraṃ spṛṣṭvā tu gurupādukāṃ ||
yasmin śastre pravarteta yoginināmaso paśuḥ | yatpurandrī vinā dravyaṃ vinā dravya na yoṣitaṃ ||
dvitīyena vinā tena rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet | jājñakena vināmantraṃ vināmantreṇa yajñarāt ||
na kadācit phalādāpti yajñaṃ ca nisphalaṃ bhavet | sadāparaśarīgena nātmānaṃ ca prakāśayet ||
acyutkāna pramānena deśakāla paśuṃ bhavet | na tīrthayātrā kurutena vayajño nameva ca ||
na ta yonopavāseṣu sadā bhaktirato hi yaḥ | gurubudhyā nametsarvaṃ devatā praṇameva ca ||
sa kule ca pra'sūtāvān viruddhocāra varjinaḥ | maṃtraśakti vihīnānāṃ praṇāmaṃ naiva kārayet ||
padaṃ vākya pramāṇaṃ ca śrutimārgāti vedinaḥ | kulopadeśa hīnānāṃ praṇāmaṃ naiva kārayet ||
kulopadeśa yuktānāṃ viruddhānāṃ kuvartināṃ | atyutthāna pramādāyāṃ praṇāmaṃ kārayet priye ||
<14b>
matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ surākumbhaṃ mantrāṇāṃ siddhidaṃ bhavet | sahakāramaśākañca krīḍālolakumārikā ||
ekavṛkṣaśmaśānañca pūjāsthānāni yāni ca | nārīśaraccandra vadanā dṛṣṭvā vande ca bhaktitaḥ ||
śrīpatreṇa vinādravyaṃ pūjā naiva tu kārayet | anyathā carate yastu pūjā ca nisphalā bhavet ||
griṣyodīkṣita mantraśca yadi svarga gato puriḥ | ekasantānake naiva prādiyogābhiṣecanaṃ ||
vālopi dīkṣitaḥ pūrva jyeṣṭasyā kulamāgataḥ | vṛddhopi dīkṣitaḥ paścāt kaniṣṭaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ ||
dvijo vā dīkṣitaḥ paścādanyajaḥ pūrvadīkṣitaḥ | dvijaḥ kaniṣṭaḥ sa jyeṣṭa iti śāstra viniścayaḥ ||
gurośca gurukanyānāṃ māṃsa śiṣyasya parasparaḥ | yathāloke puriścaiva sannidhau naiva pūjayet ||
putraścāpi vannaṃ ca striyaḥ sarvāmaheśvari | gururarthe ca kārpaṇyaṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet ||
guruvarge jyeṣṭavarge naiva pūjāvalādikaṃ | anuṣṭānaṃ na kurvīta sasta(?)ṣāṃ caiva kārayet ||
<15a>
jyeṣṭho dīkṣita matraśca dabhiṣekādi varjitaḥ | kaniṣṭho yaṃ diśaṃ pūrṇaṃ kramapūjāṃ samācaret ||
lalātamukhaṃ vṛttākṣi śrutighrāṇa gaṇḍayo | oṣṭadantostamāṃgasya doḥsaṃdhagraheṣu ca ||
pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhato nābhau jathare hṛdayāṃśake | kakudvaṃge ca kṛtpūrvaṃ pānipāda tarantathā ||
jaṭharānānamontyasya mātṛkānāṃ yathā kramāt | tasminnivedya tatsarvaṃ śeṣaṃ bhuṃjita pārvati ||
sthambhanaṃ caturasraṃ syān matsyāṃ gomukhameva ca | yoni surabhi vikhyātā mudrāpaṃca namaskṛtā ||
gururvā gurupatnī vā putrovātha samācaret | jyeṣṭhā vā vyarcanā madhye sadyaśiṣyorcanāntyajet ||
ājñāyā pūjayechiṣya iti śāstresya nirṇayaḥ | guro jyeṣṭa vadhuśca tathā vakulanāyike ||
nopaviśyapine dravyaṃ viniśāstrasya nirṇayaṃḥ | svapātrevasthitaṃ dravyaṃ vandanā bhairavāya caḥ ||
sa narasiddhihāniḥ syādvipadaśca pade pade | padā tu paramānando divyapānena jāyate ||
<15b>
tadātmamamajāyāntu raurava narakaṃ vrajet | paradattārghapātraṃ ca pādukāmūlamantrataṃ ||
cakramadhye grahītavyamanyathā patanaṃ bhavet | ekapātraṃ na kartavyaṃ yadi sākṣān kuleśvaśvarī ||
mantrāḥ parāṅmukhā yānti vipadaśca pade pade | matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā madyaṃ mudrāmaithunameva ca ||
kuryā ca guru bhaktiśca tuṭyarthaṃ ca varānane | dāridra nāśinī mudrā duḥkhākara(?) svarūpiṇī ||
kuṣṭarogopaśamanī tasmānmudrāṃ sadārcane | adīkṣitairaṇācārai aniṣṭañca vivarjitaiḥ ||
sa paśuścaiva vyaktavya iti śāstra viniścayaḥ | avasyai samaya draṣṭaiḥ kuryāddravyaṃ sa gachati ||
aduṣṭairanya puruṣairdeśāntara nivāsibhiḥ | vināsaṃketa yogena na kuryāddravya sasmṛtaṃ ||
āsanaṃ samanaṃ caiva bhojanavastrabhūṣaṇaṃ | pareravāṃ naiva kartavyaṃ yadīchedaiśvarī kalāṃ ||
adīkṣitena yaḥ kuryā pānabhojanasaṃgati | śrīcakraṃ kārayed devi satsaṃsargādviśuddhaye ||
strīsuptaṃ gurusuptaṃ ca jyeṣṭa suptaṃ ca nāsvakāṃ | anāhūtaśca yoga chedā hūtā yo na gachati ||
śrīcakraṃ pratimūḍhātmā yoginī sāpa māpnuyāt |
<16a>
bhojanānte viṣapānaṃ pānānte bhojanaṃ viṣaṃ | bhuktā ca mahā ca pītvā ca kuladravyaṃ nivedaye ||
devatāśāpamāpnoti rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet | bhojanāṃnte pānaviṣaṃ pānānte bhojanaṃ viṣaṃ ||
amṛtaṃ tada vijānīyādityarthaḥ sa kameva caḥ | cakramadhye ghaṭe bhagnaṃ pātre vā patite yadi ||
dīpanāśā pramāṇañca śrīcakraṃ kārayet punaḥ | pātramādhārayedyastu yasthāpayati mūḍhadhīḥ ||
yoginī śāpamāpnoti vipadaśca pade pade | pūjāgoṣṭaṃ ca no kuryāt pramādādahikārakeḥ ||
pūjā nisphalatā tasya yoginī sāpamāpnuyāt | mūladīkṣā vihīnaṃ ca pūjāṃ caivā paretsadā ||
gurusāpaṃ samasādyaṃ yoginī śāpamāpnuyāt | ekahasta pibeddravyaṃ mudrā caivāpavarjitaṃ ||
savasennarake ghore yāvadindroścaturdaśaḥ | ekāsane niśānātha maccayet kuladevatāṃ ||
sapustaścaiva vijñeyaḥ prāyaścitaṃ ca kārayet | gātraṃ caiva vitānaṃ ca kaulānugraha vigrahau ||
yadeva patanaṃ loke na devotpādanaṃ kule | lokotkṛṣṭaṃ ca niḥkṛṣṭaṃ vikraṃ ca tathottamaṃ ||
<16b>
īśvara uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi mantrayoga yathāvidhi | ārtovidhāyamanasādhakaḥ saṃprapūjeyet ||
deśe vānapare grāme japatyobhaḥ prajāyate | te sthāne āsanaṃ dattaṃ smarejjaya na maṇḍalā ||
[iti śrīkulācāranirṇaye paṭalaṃ samāptaṃ] ||
aṣṭi tatvāṃti me jantorabhyaṣṭeḥ sādhanocyate | jñānināṃ karmiṇāṃ caiva sarvathātyaṣṭi rucyate ||
karmātmīlayate jñānaṃ jñānena śivatā bhave | śivaikyameva muktisyādataḥ sarvakarma samācaret ||
paravyāpti gato yasya deśiko jyeṣṭa eva vā | kaniṣṭo vā svayaṃ tasya deśikatvaṃ gatena saṃ ||
ātmanā vāpi kenārpityaṣṭi pannana kārayet | yatu jñānakriyā tīvrādatyā sācicirā śive ||
mṛtyujñātvātmanonidvāntatpūrvaṃ saptame dine | paṃcamevā tṛtīye vā prathamevā svaśaktitaḥ ||
ārabhya pratyahaṃ devi tvatpūjā caraṇāntikaṃ | pūrvāmṛtyudivase gotri bhiyajvanāṃ gaṇaiḥ ||
śobhinībhiśca tanmadhya madhyāsīnaṃ guruṃ paraṃ | sarvopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya yoginī dravya pūjakaiḥ ||
<17a>
praṇipatyakṣamasveha māmanā cāriṇaṃ prabho | mayākṛtaṃ yaduṣkarma prasīdasukṛta kuru ||
vijñāpyevaṃ guruṃ śiṣyo svartrinānidhanāni ca | bhṛtyaputrakalatrādi śarīraṃ cānmanma saha ||
etasarvaṃ gṛhāṇeti vijñāpya gurave dadet | paravyāpto guruścaitanmadhya śrīpādukā guroḥ ||
śuddhāsane pratiṣṭhāpya saṃpūjyaiva nivedayet | vyādhyādi nātha pūjāyāmaśaktau padyaso bhavet ||
jyeṣṭhaiḥ kaniṣṭhaiḥ pūrvairvā guropūjāṃ tu kārayet | mṛtesminnāsti gururvātha sadasvadabhāvataḥ ||
tadārjita dhanaṃ sarvaṃ caturddhādi bhaje tataḥ | bhādvayaṃ kalatrebhyo datvānyabhyo dvayantathā ||
dvayamabhyaṣṭi putrāyā bhāve bhāga dvayordvayoḥ | gurave ca sadasyebhyo gurvabhāve guroḥ kule ||
datvāśiṣyatratrāvaṃ paścāt prakṣālya kusumādibhiḥ | alaṃkṛtya smaśānītaṃ nātvā tatra nidhīpayet ||
saṃhārakramaśastasya dehe nyastāṃ pravinyaset | sahīramudrayādāya devatāstasya vehanaḥ ||
svadehe vinyaset paścāśāntāgau viśvaghasmare | dhyātvā śrībhairavaṃ tantra natvātmamithuna dvayaṃ ||
<17b>
vighnadhanaṃ bhāsta (* *) danaleśuci vacase | mahānalāya mahase viśvaika haviṣe namaḥ ||
iti mantra samuccārya kunachivayaṃ havi | svalpaddaurvihigaṃ bhāga dvayasarvadhanādhikaṃ ||
vibhagyatatsuvidhinā śrāddha kuryāt sahādaraṃ | āsanaṃ śāpanaṃ pānaṃ vāsāsi vividhāni ca ||
pānīya bhuktapātrāṇi sarvoya karaṇāni ca | sarvopacāra sahitaṃ bhūmīṃ ca gurave dadet ||
gurusthānīyakebhyo vāsagotrebhyotha vā punaḥ | kaulikebhyothavā deyaṃ paśubhyo tadācana ||
maraṇādi namārabhya māsevātha dāśāhnikaṃ | cakrapūjāsamāyuktaṃ yāgaṃ kuryād dine pratiḥ ||
māsāhe vādaśāhe vā yoginyo yoginopi vā | prātani mantryasubhrātārācārbāhuya sādaraṃ ||
pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā nivedaya (* *) nānta | saṃpūjya śivabhairkyarthaṃ gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ||
sāpuṃnya vyaṃjanaṃ datvā dakṣiṇāṃ camba śāntitaḥ | sādhārāṇi vinikṣipya pātrāṇi gurutaḥ pṛthak ||
divya ityeṇasaṃpūjya māṃsamatsyodanādibhiḥ | sāyūpaḥ vyaṃjanaṃ datvā dakṣiṇāṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ ||
<18a>
yoginī cakra pūjānte kalaśasthāpayedatha | śālitandula madhyastha divyadravyeṇa pūritaṃ ||
vastra dvayena saṃveṣṭya navaratnaṃ vinikṣipet | navātma mithunaiścāpi vaśinyādibhireva ca ||
mūlenāpi samāmaṃtryena dūrdhvaṃ kaśyabhājanaṃ | suvarṇaropyapratiniśrepi cātrasaṃkṣipet ||
navātmanāthaṃ saṃsthāpya kalaśā sthita vāriṇi | tatra pretaṃ vicintyārtha pūjayet kuśumādibhiḥ ||
śālipiṣṭa kṛtadīpabhājanaṃ dvādaśāṃgulaṃ | tatpātre sthāpayet pātra manunānena tatparaḥ ||
dīpaṃ prajvālya gavyena ghṛtena parameśvari | vidyārūpaṃ vicityārthamanunānena tatparaṃ ||
svargārohapasopānaṃ niśrevitvadhirohinī | namāroyapaprāge divyasvecarapī padaṃ ||
iti mantraṃ samuccārya ṣaṭtriṃśattatvarūpiṇīṃ | niśreṇikāṃ samāropya nayedūrddha krameṇa tu ||
pṛthvī tatvaṃ layaṃ nītvā śivatatva padāvadhi | tatvātīte paredhāmni prakāśānanda vigrahe ||
nirvikalpe nirābhāse caitanye tatra yojayet |
<18b>
praṇamya yoginī cakraṃ kriyeyaṃ sa parā bhavet | iti vijñāpya madyādyaiḥ prīṇayedyoginī gaṇaṃ ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryā sā nandaṃ kaulikaiḥ saha | prātaḥ pūrṇātmavaṃ kuryā cakra pūjā puraḥsaraṃ ||
ulūkhale samāropya haridrā mantramastriṇaḥ | mūlena yoginībhistā mūlenāpi ca cūrṇayet ||
guruve devatāyai nā mūle naiva samarpayet | bhairavānāñca śāktīnāṃ pratyaikaṃ mūddhni nikṣipet ||
pūjayed yoginī cakramācāryāya sadakṣiṇāṃ | praṇamya prārthanā pūrvaṃ pradadyāt pratimādikaṃ ||
yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ nityaṃ śaktimekā samarcayet | trimāse vā mṛte trākṣe nidhovā vatsarovadhi ||
pūjaye yoginī cakraṃ matsyamāṃsaudanādibhiḥ | saṃvatsarasamāpūrṇa bāhyābhyaṃtara pūjanaṃ ||
kṛtvākhila kramāṇāṃ ca tatvātītai parātpare | nirābhāse raśe śānte śīvakūrvīta yojanaṃ ||
tataḥ pratyandamevaṃ hi kuryādṛkṣethavā nidhau | kulajñānavihīnāye saṃsāra bhayamāchitāḥ ||
maraṇāt pūrvaṃmatīti gurujyeṣṭamathāpi vā |
<19a>
svagotrajñātvā śātyarthaṃ guru tatvā prayatnataḥ | saṃtoṣye dhanaṃ dhānyādyaimādaraṃ vihitāṃjali ||
deveśa deva svīkṛtya rakṣārakṣāṃ svamāṃ prabhā | mahyaṃ prasīdamannātha caivaṃ vijñāpaya vaṣṭadhaḥ ||
rogādajñamṛte tasya putryavādyā svagotrajā | svaśāntyān gṛṇambitra datvāṃ tvaṣṭiṃ ca kārayet ||
śavasaṃhāramārabhya sarvavatsarāvadhi | sādhāraṇa tu sarveṣāṃ karmavāṃtyaṣṭike mate ||
[iti tatvāmarśāṃtyaṣṭikramaḥ aṣṭādaśollāsaḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ] ||
subhagānandanāthamate tu idaṃ aṣṭādaśollāśastu īśvaroktaṃ vā kvacit ācāryai kṛtaṃ vaktuṃ naiva sakyate sādhakenāpi vicāraṃ kṛtvā karmādikaṃ kuryāt iti samvat (1929) śubham ||
